leg.text: Corondor is the island where Dakkon forges the Blackblade, sacrificing his own blood, then his son Daron, then countless slaves, and where Geyadrone receives it and steals Dakkon's soul by stabbing his shadow.
Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar and sets about conquering the island, and the Son of Carth escapes her dungeons and binds himself to Dakkon with the Amulet of Ti-Fu.
Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, until Dihada reveals the monk was herself and her glyph steals Dakkon's spark.

Sivitri sparks as a young Corondor girl and raids the southeast with her dragon horde until a healer brews a poppy poison that kills dozens of her dragons, and Ravidel later lures six planeswalkers to the island with the Mox Beacon to battle in the Planeswalker War.
